name: Snare Hook
description:
The character deals +2 DMG with their Elemental Burst.
When you trigger an Elemental Reaction: Gain 1 stack of Phantom Flash. When Phantom Flash is at 2 or more stacks, consume 2 stacks of Phantom Flash to grant the attached character 1 Energy.
(Only Bow characters can equip this. A character can equip a maximum of 1 Weapon)

storytext:
"There are few truly inescapable traps in this world, for even the densest web can be threaded with a needle.
Glimmers of hope can be found between the hooks and cages of even a trap set to kill.
Just as no one can fully lock away their heart, even the most cautious defenses must eventually falter."
